about_the_game:
※This DEMO is only tested on Win10 system. There may be some problems with other operating systems or versions.

Oh, remember not to drag the PPT when "You" is falling, "You" will fall out (this is a bug)※

Hi, players! Welcome to Window No. 8: Millennium Demo.

This demo contains the first five chapters of the full version of the game and a side ending (the full version of the game has eight chapters and multiple endings).

In the first chapter of the game, we will start with some small games, I believe you will like them.

Don't worry, they are all very simple small games, I believe you must have played them when you were a child.

Oh, you asked if there will be any problems with the game, don't worry, these games don't have any jump kills, only pure fun.

Well... I admit that there may be some small problems, but don't worry!

See this hand?

Once there is a problem in the game, I will help you solve it on the spot.

Oh, there may be some supernatural events.

But this is all within my control.

I will clear these anomalies immediately.

At the same time, in order to better guide you, in the second chapter, you will learn our purpose through PPT so that you can better understand this system.

Please remember that this system is completely based on you, you are your own master.

When we come to the third chapter of the game, we will have some easy tests. Don't worry, these are some simple test questions, I think you will be able to answer them easily (I think this thing is an apple?)

Of course, we don't just have picture recognition questions, we also have grammar questions, I think you will be able to answer them quickly.

Then I want to... some math questions!

Oh, don't worry about the answer in the picture, it's just an example, you can only get the correct answer through a computer.

After all, the human brain is not very accurate, right?

And in the fourth chapter, when you become one of us, you will look for loopholes in the photos through the perspective window.

Don't worry, these are all ordinary photos, and there is absolutely no weird thing in them.

When you come to the fifth chapter, which is the last chapter of the demo, you will exercise your mind through meditation.

I believe that after 365 days, your mind will be sublimated.

(Note: There are no other endings for this chapter!)

The full version of the game will unlock all eight chapters, as well as different side endings.

When you have collected all the endings, I will be waiting for you in the true ending.

Player.

Game Features

  • Y2K Visual Effects

This game has a unique Y2K visual style, reminiscent of classic games from the 90s.

  • META Elements

Some puzzles in the game require the use of files outside the game, such as pictures or consoles.

  • Don't worry

This game looks like a virus, but it actually won't cause any damage to your computer, it's just some performance.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains murder and suicide scenes
